summary: QR Table Ordering feature E2E tested: 10/10 backend pytest passed (create/list/resolve/rotate/menu/settings/order/refund + auth gates). Frontend E2E flow verified: customer scans /order/qr/<token>, sees merchant 'Test Bistro', table label 'E2E_Test', menu item 'Pizza Margherita' (€8.50), adds to cart, cart CTA total €8.50 rendered, submit -> success screen with order_id 'qro_7a2caa93eaae' and €8.50 total. Merchant page /merchant/qr-tables renders 4 table cards with QR codes, all 3 tabs (Tische/Bestellungen/Einstellungen) switch correctly. Cloak verified: order page has no BottomNav and no CookieBanner.

issues: CookieBanner overlaps the bottom of the page (overlays content) — minor UX, not blocking. Banner correctly hidden on /order/qr/* customer page.

critical_code_review_comments: qr_table_order.py line 178-180: datetime.fromisoformat with .replace('Z','+00:00') is safe but expires_at is always set with isoformat() (no Z) — current implementation works.
QrOrderPage.jsx scope filter is heuristic (regex on category) — items without 'getr|drink|bar' category default to food scope. Consider explicit scope field on menu items for accuracy.

MerchantQrTablesPage.jsx loadSettings is a no-op (no GET endpoint) — current scopes/acceptance_mode shown are hardcoded defaults, not actual saved settings. Consider adding GET /api/merchant/qr-settings/{merchant_id}.

Merchant page uses user.merchant_id || user.user_id || user.id || localStorage.bb_merchant_id — for the test merchant, login returns user.id which equals merchant_id, so works. For real-world merchants this may need a dedicated merchant_id resolver.
Console shows several background 404/401 errors (unrelated endpoints like /api/notifications etc.) — not caused by this feature but noisy.
test_credentials: Merchant haendler@bidblitz.com / Haendler2026!, Customer kunde@bidblitz.com / Kunde2026! — both work via /api/auth/login (cookie-based access_token + refresh_token).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test tables (TEST_Table, E2E_Test, E2E2) via merchant API. 1 test order qro_7a2caa93eaae placed and another qro_xxx rejected+refunded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is COOKIE-BASED (httponly access_token in response cookies). Login: POST /api/auth/login {email,password} -> sets cookies, returns user obj (no token in body). For curl/requests use a Session() and the cookies are auto-attached. For Playwright, copy cookies from a requests.Session() to page.context.add_cookies with value=str(c.value). QR tokens have 5-min sliding window TTL — rotate via POST /api/merchant/qr-tables/{table_id}/rotate before each order test. User wallet field is 'balance' (NOT wallet_balance). Test bistro merchant_id=69d0126144299a2e0d94c788 has a 'Pizza Margherita' €8.50 menu item.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Backend already smoke-tested by main agent. Frontend integration confirmed working end-to-end via Playwright.
